findings.claim: Pre-ops card alone makes production agent sessions safe
findings.issue: AISVS C9 and the Agent Security Cheat Sheet require runtime enforcement (block until approval, bind params, fail closed). A filled markdown card without wiring is Appendix B's documented pitfall.
findings.recommendation: Keep must-list: card + Hold/Apply + protected main/Environments; never treat card completion as runtime authorization.

findings.claim: GitHub Environment required reviewers are always available for personal private repos
findings.issue: GitHub docs note plan/visibility limits for required reviewers on Environments. Designing solely around Environments would fail closed incorrectly or be silently skipped.
findings.recommendation: Document local Hold/Apply as the universal Tier-3 gate; treat Environments as should when plan allows.

findings.issue: Brief-004 and AISVS C9.2.6/AC.8 address independent review of artifacts and self-merge prohibition. Pre-ops answers a different question (whether to aim tools at prod).
findings.recommendation: Keep the separation table in §1.1; require both for Tier ≥2 code changes that also touch prod paths.

findings.claim: AWS three-tier model maps 1:1 to a household of one human
findings.issue: AGENTOPS06-BP03 assumes technical lead + business owner. A solo operator is both; multi-stakeholder language can become rubber-stamp self-approval.
findings.recommendation: For solo fleets, Tier 3 requires time-separated Apply (sleep on it) or a second agent family critic plus human Apply — never same-chat self-approve.

findings.claim: Simulated peer reviewer is an independent pre-ops authority
findings.issue: Same Grok Bot weekly burn synthesizer and peer_reviewer share model family and pool.
findings.recommendation: Label independence quality; Prefer external /interrogate or cross-family critic before encoding the Pre-ops Origin agent as fleet law.

strengths: Clear separation of pre-ops vs Peer Arena vs Hold/Apply vs connector trust
Concrete risk-card schema with one-thing-first and reversibility classes
21 live-fetched http citations spanning AISVS/LLM06/Agentic Top10, AWS Lens, change-control checklists, NIST, LangGraph/OpenAI HITL, GitHub
Honest GitHub plan-limit caveat + local Hold fallback
Explicit exclusion of vertical/regulated practice encoding
